command: cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && echo '=== TREE docs/ ===' && find docs -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) | sort && echo '=== STATUS / FRONT-MATTER (first 25 lines per file) ===' && for f in $(find docs -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' \) | sort); do echo "--- $f ---"; head -25 "$f" | sed -n '1,25p'; echo; done && echo '=== GIT LAST-COMMIT PER DOC FILE ===' && for f in $(find docs -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' \) | sort); do d=$(git log -1 --format='%cI %h %s' -- "$f" 2>/dev/null); echo "$d  | $f"; done | sort -r && echo '=== ACTIVE PLAN (most recent) ===' && ls -lt docs/plans/wiring/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
